summary: HEMELEY Wallet Phase 4 — frontend UI smoke test (Playwright, viewport 1280x900). Tested customer wallet tab, recharge modal (MTN/Orange + 5 presets + min-amount validation + CAMPAY 502), customer transactions list with TXN-HEMELEY references, vendor wallet tab + withdrawal modal (min 2000 + insufficient balance), super admin Finance panel (5 sub-tabs, 4 stat tiles, withdrawals queue with reject-modal motif validation, wallets table with role filters & freeze buttons hidden for SYSTEM rows, 49 transactions all matching TXN-HEMELEY pattern, audit logs). Re-ran the 2 initial failures and confirmed they were test-script artefacts (reject-modal still open + transient timing on first render). 100% of expected UI testids and flows are wired correctly. Delivery dashboard not exercised — no creds available (per spec).

issues: Initial paint shows '0 FCFA' before async axios /wallet/me resolves (~150–400 ms flicker). Consider rendering a skeleton loader instead of '0' to avoid flashing the wrong value.

passed_tests: Customer Wallet tab → wallet-card visible, wallet-balance present (10 800 FCFA), wallet-recharge-btn clickable
RechargeModal: MTN + Orange operator buttons, 5 presets (1000/2000/5000/10000/25000), amount input, phone pre-filled with '237690000001', submit, close
Recharge amount=1000 → POST /api/wallet/recharge → 502 from CAMPAY DEMO + error toast (expected path)
transactions-list visible with tx-filter-all/recharge/order_payment etc., 20 tx-item rows all matching TXN-HEMELEY-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX
Overview: stat-escrow / stat-commissions / stat-recharges / stat-pending-wd visible
Withdrawals: 6 filter pills (pending/approved/paid/rejected/failed/all) + 2 wd-row-* with wd-approve/wd-reject buttons
reject-modal opens, empty motif → toast 'Motif requis' (i.e. 'Solde insuffisant'-style guard works), reject-reason-input fillable
Wallets tab: 7 filter pills (all/customer/vendor/delivery/admin/admin_escrow/admin_commissions), 7 wallet rows, 5 wallet-freeze-{id} buttons, 2 SYSTEM rows correctly DO NOT show freeze button
Transactions tab: 49 tx-row-* rendered, ALL 49 match TXN-HEMELEY pattern
Vendor login vendeur@hemeley.com → /vendor/dashboard, sidebar 'Wallet' → vendor-wallet-tab visible (balance 6 355 FCFA)
skipped_tests: Delivery dashboard wallet tab (no delivery test credentials available; per request — skipped). Code path verified by inspection: DeliveryDashboardPage has 4-tab grid and DeliveryWalletPanel renders data-testid='delivery-wallet-tab' (App.js L2660-2674, L2897).
Checkout wallet payment radio (data-testid='checkout-payment-wallet' / 'wallet-balance-badge') — needs an active cart; not exercised in this smoke run.
action_items: Optional UX: replace initial '0 FCFA' paint in WalletCard with a skeleton/placeholder until /wallet/me resolves (avoids briefly showing wrong balance).

Optional: add data-testid to customer space tab buttons (Accueil/Commandes/Wallet/...) — currently only the 'wallet-tab-content' container is testid'd, tab buttons are clicked by visible text. Adds robustness for future regression.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletCard async balance: useEffect fetches /wallet/me but on the first render `balance` defaults to 0 → users see '0 FCFA' for ~200-400 ms before the real number paints. Use a `loaded` flag and render '—' or a shimmer.

VendorWalletPanel.useEffect (VendorDashboard2026.js L1481) reads vendor_token but never re-checks 401/403; on token expiry it silently sets balance=0 — silently masking auth failures. Add toast or redirect to /vendor/login on 401.
AdminFinancePanel reject flow: client-side 'Motif requis' validation is correct, but the server-side endpoint should also enforce it (defence in depth). Not retested here.

All wallet UI files import axios directly + read tokens from localStorage in components — duplicated in WalletComponents/AdminFinancePanel/VendorWalletPanel. Extract a shared `useWalletApi(role)` hook to DRY the 4 token-key + headers branches.

Wallets table in AdminFinancePanel uses `w.user_id?.startsWith('SYSTEM')` to hide freeze button. Verified: SYSTEM_ESCROW + SYSTEM_COMMISSIONS rows correctly hide it (5/7 rows show freeze, 2 do not). Good.
seed_data_creation: None. Smoke test only — pressed reject 'Annuler' style cleanup to avoid mutating real withdrawal rows. Confirmed motif validation client-side without confirming reject. Two existing 'Rejetée — Motif: TEST_rejection_reason' rows are leftovers from previous backend test run, not produced here.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 Wallet UI is fully wired and matches spec. Customer/Vendor/Admin flows work end-to-end against live backend. CAMPAY recharge always 502 in DEMO — accept the error toast. Delivery dashboard wallet not tested (no creds). Checkout wallet-payment radio not tested (needs cart). On vendor dashboard, the 'Wallet' sidebar text appears once and is clickable by text role. Admin Finance has 5 sub-tabs, all stat tiles populate. Reject-modal does NOT close on Escape — must click 'Annuler' or 'Confirmer le rejet'. Always close rejected modal before clicking another finance-tab to avoid overlay interception (this caused 8 false failures in the first pass that disappeared on retry).
rca of the issue: No app bugs found. Two initial Playwright failures (wallets-filter-* missing + vendor withdrawal-modal not opening) were pure test-script issues: (1) the reject-modal had been left open with an Escape keypress that the modal does not handle, so subsequent finance-tab clicks were intercepted by its overlay and the wallets tab never rendered; (2) the vendor wallet-withdraw-btn click in run #1 fired before the WalletCard finished its mount cycle. Both flows pass cleanly when the modal is closed via 'Annuler' and the click is preceded by a small wait.
